chapter_name: Foundational Basis of Physical Education and Well-being
learning_objective: 🎯 Discover how moving your body and staying active builds a super strong foundation for lifelong health, a sharp mind, and unstoppable energy!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Physical Education is not just about playing games on the field! It is the amazing science of understanding how your body moves, grows, and stays strong through regular physical activity.

True well-being means feeling great in three different ways: Physical (having a strong, active body), Mental (keeping a focused, calm, and happy mind), and Social (playing fair and making great friends on a team).
Did you know that running or playing a sport actually helps you study better? When you exercise, your brain gets fresh oxygen, which reduces stress and boosts your memory and focus!
Creating simple daily habits right now, like maintaining a straight posture while sitting or stretching every morning, acts like a protective shield for your body as you grow older.

fun_activity.title: 🏆 The Digroz Learning Morning Stretch
fun_activity.instructions: Set a timer for just 5 minutes as soon as you wake up. Do simple stretches like reaching high for the sky and gently touching your toes to wake up your muscles for a champion's day!

quick_recap: ⭐ Physical education trains your body and mind to work together as a perfect team.
⭐ Total well-being involves being physically fit, mentally happy, and socially friendly.
⭐ Daily movement is the ultimate secret to unlocking endless energy and feeling great every single day!
